text:
Ben: Edge proxy started adding X-Org and X-Project on forwarded requests when SA exchange happens. Right now console maps billing to key->project if present, otherwise org default. Question: do we honor X-Project header for billing/quota, or keep binding strictly to the key's project? Need rollout plan + telemetry.

Mina: I'd rather show both in the UI (effective vs inferred) so users can see what was used. But agree we should NOT silently change enforcement.

Carla: Product input: customers asked for "explainable billing" — a tooltip + small badge that says "inferred" could work. For rollout, label any header-derived project as "inferred" for 2 weeks before making it primary.

Dave: Telemetry note: our logs show ~6% of requests include X-Org but lack an internal project claim. If we switch mapping we'll see billing deltas and SLO shifts. Need canary + metric thresholds.

Ben: Proposal: add backend flag prefer_header_project (default false). Start canary at 10% of traffic for 48h; surface diff metrics. If we exceed billing_delta > 1% or quota-violation changes, roll back.

Mina: Enforcement question: if header project != key project, do we allow the header? Security risk unless it's signed by our exchange service.

Carla: Policy: only honor header when Signed-Exchange header present (e.g., X-Exchange-Sig). Otherwise ignore header and surface a console warning.

Ben: Implementation notes (sketch):
```
// request auth pipeline pseudo
auth = validate_api_key(key)
if (signed_exchange_present && prefer_header_project) {
  auth.effective_project = header.project
  auth.derived_reason = "signed-exchange"
} else {
  auth.effective_project = auth.key_project
  auth.derived_reason = "key-assigned"
}
log({ key_id: key.id, key_project: auth.key_project, effective_project: auth.effective_project, derived_reason: auth.derived_reason })
```

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: prefer_header_project=true rolled to 10% of edge traffic (canary id 2026-03-billing-01)

Dave: Add telemetry counters: `billing.derived_project.swap_rate`, `billing.delta_amount_percent`, and an alert if swap_rate>0.5% AND delta_amount_percent>1%.

Mina: Edge case: legacy "projectless" keys — we'll render as "org-level" and not infer a project unless signed-exchange gives one.

Ben: Plan: I'll open PR with flag + logging changes, add dashboard panels for the metrics, then schedule canary. Targeting week-of-Mon for rollout.

Carla: Sounds good. @Ben please add a console banner for the first 2 weeks explaining "inferred project" behavior.

Mina: ACK

Dave: ACK

Ben: Opening PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 :thumbsup:
